description: Na₈Mg(FeO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.89 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two FeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.58 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.50 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.46 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.54 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.79 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.42 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.73 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, edges with two NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.11 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.99 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-1.97 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃MgFe trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 64°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Fe atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Fe atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom.
